searchText: Verkle Implementers Call in 10 minutes https://meet.google.com/odf-tghm-ttu regarding the discussion on the docs and the EIP: https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/verkle_tree_eip 1. it's referring to bandersnatch, shouldn't it be banderwagon?: ``` o = bandersnatch.add(o, bandersnatch.mul(generator, child)) ``` It's a simple thing, but people get confused with the details. 2. There are no mentions of IPA, multiproof, etc, this is more on Dankrad's blog and Kev's hackmd. 3. There are comments from Gottfried like: ``` As defined, extension_and_suffix_tree return a Point, not an int, so type-hinting is wrong or a group_to_field is missing. ``` these are just some examples So this also makes things confusing for developers implementing verkle tries. I've been in contact with 4-5 people involved in this as newcomers, so that's my conclusion. Not saying there are no clear specs(in 15 different places), but this confusion makes us take more time understanding what's actually needed So just wrote the first few things that came to my mind, probably there are more ways to improve docs. cc <@1010280066028142662> Thanks! Fair points. That EIP may be a bit outdated. Probably best to refer to: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6800 <@973535409013411850>, I can take a look at the current eips, and we can try improving or clarifying things. We can work together to check if things look better after and/or answer things you and other found confusing.

excerpts.content:
regarding the discussion on the docs and the EIP: https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/verkle_tree_eip 

1. it's referring to bandersnatch, shouldn't it be banderwagon?:
```
        o = bandersnatch.add(o, bandersnatch.mul(generator, child))
```
It's a simple thing, but people get confused with the details.

2. There are no mentions of IPA, multiproof, etc, this is more on Dankrad's blog and Kev's hackmd.

3. There are comments from Gottfried like:
```
As defined, extension_and_suffix_tree return a Point, not an int, so type-hinting is wrong or a group_to_field is missing.
```
these are just some examples
So this also makes things confusing for developers implementing verkle tries. I've been in contact with 4-5 people involved in this as newcomers, so that's my conclusion. Not saying there are no clear specs(in 15 different places), but this confusion makes us take more time understanding what's actually needed


So just wrote the first few things that came to my mind, probably there are more ways to improve docs. cc <@1010280066028142662>
